name: Uganda

fees.name: Uganda Tourist Visa (single entry, e-visa)
fees.validity: Approval valid 90 days from approval; grants up to 3 months stay
fees.notes: Applied for online via visas.immigration.go.ug. Non-refundable; online payments subject to a bank/card surcharge.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.notes: Non-refundable; payments subject to a bank charge.

fees.name: East African Tourist Visa (Uganda/Kenya/Rwanda joint visa)
fees.validity: 90 days from date of issue, multiple entry within the 3-country bloc, not renewable
fees.applies: all (issuing country must be first entry point)
fees.notes: Covers Uganda, Kenya and Rwanda only; for tourism purposes, employment prohibited.

fees.name: Multiple-Entry Visa (6-12 months)
fees.notes: Also offered at 24 months for USD 200. Not a work permit.

fees.name: Multiple-Entry Visa (24 months)
fees.notes: Longer-validity tier of the multiple-entry visa.

free_visa_notes: Uganda operates a flat-fee e-visa system published by the National Citizenship and Immigration Control (NCIC) portal; no nationality-based reciprocity fee schedule was found on official sources for the tracked nationalities (IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN) as of this record's date - all pay the same standard fees listed above. All applications are processed directly through the government e-visa portal (visas.immigration.go.ug); no VFS Global/TLScontact/BLS outsourced centre is used for Uganda visas.
